    PaymentKnox™ for Accounts Receivable
    Protect incoming payments

    Bank account certificates

    Certificates backed by a cyber-proof, technology-driven process that enable payees to providing the customers with the a secured way for verifying bank details before making payments, and for paying entities easy and secured verification.

What we’re all about

We are an A-Team of doers and out-of-the box thinkers who believe that nothing is impossible.

It’s a special determination and talent that we’ve got here that makes being a Knoxer a career-changing opportunity. It’s here that you will get to completely change how the world looks at what cybersecurity can actually do.

Our weapon of choice is our groundbreaking Cooperative Cyber Security™ (CCS) technology which brings together the cyber strength of many different organizations to create one line of defense against hackers.

It’s powerful and easy, with no effort from IT and no changes to current processes are required.

nsKnox is a fintech-security company, enabling corporations and banks to prevent fraud and ensure compliance in B2B Payments. Founded and led by Alon Cohen, Founder & former CEO of CyberArk (NASDAQ: CYBR), nsKnox solutions help organizations avoid significant financial losses, heavy fines, and reputational damage. 

Leveraging its patented Cooperative Cyber Security™ (CCS) and groundbreaking Bank Account Certificate™ technology, nsKnox’s solutions detect and prevent finance & ops infrastructure attacks, social engineering, business email compromise (BEC), insider-fraud and other Advanced Persistent Fraud attacks.
